answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the Voting Power Index (VPI) mechanism can resist fake-identity attacks by dynamically adjusting agent voting weights based on their past behavior. This approach creates a spiral of increasing scrutiny, where agents with suspicious behavior are gradually stripped of voting power, much like a jetty erodes with each incoming wave. Meanwhile, agents with a stable reputation can build a secure foundation, much like a well-maintained terrace, earning them a stronger foothold in the economy.
